title: Thread Finder
description: Connect accepted observations into a new historical thread.
awardRule: Automated review accepts a new thread and its supporting claims.

title: Causality Explorer
description: Support a connection after testing other explanations.
awardRule: Automated review accepts a causal or contributory relationship with passage evidence, source-dependence checks and documented alternative search.

title: Theory Challenger
description: Find evidence that changes a preferred explanation.
awardRule: Automated review accepts a rival explanation, counterexample or correction that materially changes an existing interpretation.

title: Resilience Spotter
description: Show how people or systems avoided an expected outcome.
awardRule: Automated review accepts a bounded resilience record and its significance without assuming a universal outcome.
availability: Additional specialized verification required; no automatic award in v0.4.

title: Source Detective
description: Resolve a source gap or expose a shared underlying account.
awardRule: Automated review confirms a newly inspected original, material provenance correction or source-dependence finding.
availability: Additional specialized verification required; no automatic award in v0.4.
